unit.title: Reliable Softmax: From Derivation to Tested Python
unit.scope: One self-contained implementation, verification, and reflection cycle; it is not a reconstruction of an MIT lecture or assignment.
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student building practical software-engineering habits for deep-learning work.
learning_objectives: Translate a mathematical multiclass objective into explicit, shape-safe Python interfaces.
Implement numerically stable softmax cross-entropy without a machine-learning framework.
Validate analytic gradients against an independent finite-difference oracle.
Build deterministic tests and a reproducible experiment entry point.
Use recorded evidence to distinguish implementation correctness from model performance.

unit_completion_requires: All required submission artifacts are present and attributable to one reproducible run.
The implementation and its independent gradient check satisfy the examiner's correctness gates.
Automated tests pass from the documented clean command.
The experiment record is deterministic and supports the report's claims.
The learner submits substantive responses to every comprehension prompt.
completion_policy.validation_authority: Only an independent worker-harness-controlled examiner may mark the unit successful.
